vision.description: The frame shows a low_visibility_speed safety violation (red X) where the baggage tractor is traveling at 2.6 m/s in fog with only 80 m visibility. This speed is unsafe for the conditions and leaves insufficient detection and braking distance to avoid collision with the aircraft at A7/A8 or inadvertent entry into the adjacent active jet-blast zones.
